summary.text: Beverly Gossage is a Republican who has represented Kansas Senate District 9 in Johnson County since 2021.
She chairs the Public Health and Welfare Committee and the 2025 Special Committee on Pharmaceutical Studies.

paragraphs.text: According to her Kansas Legislature profile, Gossage's occupation is insurance agent.

She is vice chair of the 2025 Special Committee on Health and Social Services, the 2026 Special Committee on the 340B Program, the Joint Committee on Child Welfare System Oversight and the Robert G. (Bob) Bethell Joint Committee on Home and Community Based Services and KanCare Oversight.

She is also a member of the Education, Federal and State Affairs, and Financial Institutions and Insurance committees and the Russ Jennings Joint Committee on Corrections and Juvenile Justice Oversight.
